conjectures.name: SPDP Repair Conjecture A
conjectures.statement: The joint span of SPDP rows is bounded by the dimension of their individual invariant subspaces under permutation of R tensor slots.
assumptions: All SPDP compiler rows are coefficient vectors of u times partial^tau p.
proof_sketch: Show that each SPDP row is permutation invariant.
Establish that the joint span of such rows cannot exceed the dimension of their individual invariant subspaces under permutations.
Demonstrate the inequality holds without assuming a universal SPDP compiler or rank-monotone hard-sheet extraction.

conjectures.name: SPDP Repair Conjecture B
conjectures.statement: The joint span of SPDP rows is bounded by the dimension of the image space of a shared linear map from a D-dimensional vector space.
assumptions: All SPDP compiler rows are coefficient vectors of u times partial^tau p.
proof_sketch: Prove that the rows lie in the image space of a shared linear map.
Show that this assumption implies a bound on the joint span without relying on SAT hardness or assuming repair functions.
Demonstrate the hypothesis holds with the necessary but not sufficient conditions for SPDP compiler.
